clips.name: floor-beat
clips.note: 2 beats/s: each tile jumps to a new colour on the beat and lit tiles decay toward dark until the next; Kotlin's pattern never repeats, this one repeats every 10 beats

clips.name: ball-spin
clips.note: tile shading repeats every 12 columns, so sliding 144 px loops seamlessly

inputs.name: progress
inputs.drives: Scene-level: n.f slides set n out and set n+1 in (a whip pan). The set itself is static at its own origin; the host translates it by -f*940 (horizontal) or +f*760 (vertical).
